title: Define client behavior after sha256 upload mismatch
description: §2.1 (line 152) says after a sha256 mismatch clients SHOULD NOT use the returned blobId, but gives no guidance on what to do next. 'Fatal upload error' is undefined. Should clients retry? Surface an error to the user? Attempt to re-upload? Report to the server? The mismatch is operationally significant — clients need a defined recovery path, not just a prohibition on using the blobId.
